messages.author: e4aa87bd25c65f41
messages.subject: No --readShiftType and --readShiftSize in featureCounts 1.6.3
parts:
Hi,

In the document SubreadUsersGuide.pdf, new options --readShiftType and --readShiftSize were listed. However, the options were not available in the version 1.6.3.

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: No --readShiftType and --readShiftSize in featureCounts 1.6.3
parts: Sorry about this. These options are currently available in the R version of the software (http://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/Rsubread.html). And they will be supported in Subread version 1.6.4 which will be released very soon.
